# Southeast Asia - Europe Joint Funding Scheme for research and innovation

> A bi-regional research and innovation funding instrument connecting Southeast Asian and European researchers, innovators, and funding organizations through joint calls, partnering tools, and collaborative projects.

The JFS facilitates international research collaboration and co-funding opportunities across Southeast Asia and Europe, with a focus on emerging technologies, sustainability, and regional innovation ecosystems. The scheme operates through coordinated calls for proposals, matchmaking events, and knowledge-sharing platforms.

## Key Topics

- Southeast Asia-Europe Joint Funding Scheme (JFS)
- Research funding and collaboration
- International cooperation
